title: Explicit superconstant lower bounds in the congested clique
formal: Is there an explicit graph decision problem, centrally solvable in polynomial time and requiring one output bit, that needs omega(1) communication rounds in the deterministic unicast congested-clique model?
context: This short research proposal states the target identified in the September 2026 fundamental-problem search. The references give the source models and related results. A full self-contained formulation and detailed progress review remain to be written.

sentences: In the congested clique, every pair of processors can communicate directly, but each link has a limited message size per round.
The question asks for an explicit graph decision problem requiring more than a constant number of deterministic unicast rounds.
The problem must have a polynomial-time centralized algorithm and only one output bit.
These restrictions prevent a lower bound from relying simply on an enormous answer or an arbitrarily hard local computation.
The challenge is to prove an unavoidable communication bottleneck despite the complete communication network and the ability to send different messages to different recipients.
